documents.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Mutual NDA for two parties exchanging confidential information.

documents.name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
documents.description: Cover page (variable terms) used together with the Common Paper standard Mutual NDA.

documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) governing access to and use of a cloud-based product or service.

documents.name: Design Partner Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement between an early-stage provider and a customer collaborating on product development.

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Service Level Agreement (SLA) defining uptime commitments, service credits, and support response times.

documents.name: Professional Services Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA) for engagements involving consulting, implementation, or other professional services.

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement (DPA) addressing GDPR, UK GDPR, and similar data protection requirements between a controller and a processor.

documents.name: Software License Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement for licensing on-premises or downloadable software.

documents.name: Partnership Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement covering co-marketing, referral, or reseller relationships between two companies.

documents.name: Pilot Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement for a time-bound, evaluation-stage deployment of a product or service.

documents.name: Business Associate Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for HIPAA-regulated arrangements involving Protected Health Information.

documents.name: AI Addendum
documents.description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum that supplements an existing agreement to cover the use of artificial intelligence features and training data.
